item.description:
**Download:** [Leise-2.2.4.zip](https://github.com/ramonfeng/leise/releases/download/v2.2.4/Leise-2.2.4.zip) — quit Leise, then replace the old `Leise.app` in your Applications folder. (First launch after replacing: System Settings → Privacy & Security → "Open Anyway", same as before — [README](https://github.com/ramonfeng/leise#readme).) This is also the one manual install for machines whose auto-update never fired — from this version on, the consent question comes to you at launch instead of hiding behind a broken first-run step.
## What changed in 2.2.4
- **The Home cards finally count what you feel.** Typing time saved leads with the same script-aware baselines (30 字/分 for Chinese, 40 words/min for English and German); "Words never left this Mac" now counts like you talk — every CJK character, every Latin word; "Moments of your voice" counts the dictations themselves instead of an hour-sum nobody can feel; and a new Energy card estimates the watt-hours a cloud speech pipeline would have burned in your place (the CO₂ math lives in the tooltip). - **Auto-update becomes reachable on machines that never saw the question.** Upgrades whose onboarding finished before the consent question existed now get asked once at launch; machines stuck on the recording test get the consent toggle right on the failure card. Both paths write the same answer, so the choice can't drift. - **Dictionary backups prune themselves.** Automatic dictionary backups now keep the 30 newest (about three days at a heavy day's pace, ~3.5 MB) instead of piling up forever — hand-made and hand-renamed backups are never touched, and nothing is deleted until the new backup has been verified readable. - **Your history can no longer be trampled by anything else on this machine.** A second app or tool opening Leise's database could silently restart its row counter and overwrite the oldest dictations; the store paths are now guarded everywhere, and if row growth ever stops advancing while saves succeed, the log says so loudly, the moment it starts. - **Every chunk leaves a trace.** Each delivered chunk now logs its landing, a polish result dropped mid-flight says so, and a polish that balloons a sentence several-fold gets a named alarm — the "half a sentence appeared twice / a paragraph vanished" reports are now answerable from the log instead of by oath.
## The essentials (unchanged)
**Apple Silicon only** (M1 or newer) · **macOS 14.4+** · about **7 GB free disk** (523 MB app + 5.9 GB speech models downloaded on first run).
A 100 % local dictation app for macOS. Your audio and your transcripts never leave your Mac; it works with the network off.
